_doc: Pricing-strategy lever + real-time pricing-screen tunables (#154 / #175). `strategies` is the dealership-wide list-price posture the player picks (persisted per save). `marketAggression` multiplies the honest market price (>1 lists above market, <1 below); `targetMarkupPct` sets the book+gross floor the suggestion never undercuts. `positionBands` are askingPrice/marketPrice ratio thresholds for the position indicator. `competitorSpread` maps each competitor's [0,1] pricing lean onto a +/- band around market for the comparables panel. Retune posture/feel here without touching code.

aggressive.label: Aggressive
aggressive.blurb: List above market — fatter gross per unit, slower turn.

market.label: Market
market.blurb: List at market — balanced gross and turn.

value.label: Value
value.blurb: List below market — thin gross, fast turn.
